$comment: A starter house style: copy this file, change the id and title, and list it (or its folder) in nui-designer.ini's `styles`. Every key is here with a neutral default; style.schema.json describes each one (an editor with JSON Schema support shows it as you type). A rule not listed under `rules`, or listed with "enabled": false, is off. Every rule also takes enabled, severity (error, warning or info), exempt (window names it skips), title and summary.
title: Example house style
description: A starting point for your own house style: a spacing grid, standard sizes, short tooltips and a small palette.

fixed-size.$comment: Turn on if windows must not be resizable.

frame.$comment: Turn on if every window's geometry must be its content plus the client's frame.

drawn-progress.hint: draw the bar instead: a track rect and a fill rect whose rect is bound

palette.$comment: List your palette's colours as [r, g, b] and turn it on.

fonts.$comment: The skin's [[fonts]] names your windows may use.

no-empty-window.$comment: A rule of the plugin (example-rules.mjs): its common settings work here too.
